name: Fushanosaurus
isnote: Described as a titanosauriform, but a 2023 reassessment suggests the shared features are widespread among sauropods and it may be a mamenchisaurid.
sum: Fushanosaurus is a sauropod from the Oxfordian Shishugou Formation of Xinjiang, China, known only from a complete right femur.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Wang et al. 2019
